meta.title: Signscape
meta.byline: Prepared for Group Corporate Affairs, Lloyds Banking Group · Confidential

overview: The week of 22–27 June 2026 sits in the post-clash period following today's combined MPC decision and ONS Labour Market release, with no confirmed Bank of England or ONS data events falling within the window itself. Activity is dominated by an active regulatory pipeline — the overdue motor finance redress Policy Statement, Consumer Duty scope consultation, and PSR card fee remedies — alongside two strongly expected Bank of England publications, the Financial Stability Report and Annual Report. No major competitor results are anticipated, so analyst focus should be on verifying expected regulatory and central-bank items against primary sources before stakeholder briefing.

patterns.name: Bank of England Financial Stability Report
patterns.desc: The bi-annual Financial Stability Report is typically published in June (Week 2) and December. If not yet released this June, it may fall in the 22–27 June window. The FT leads on systemic risk findings and a Governor press conference follows publication; national titles focus on consumer and housing implications.
patterns.action: Monitor Bank of England press releases from Week 1. Note any Lloyds Banking Group-specific references and prepare housing/consumer reaction lines.

patterns.name: Bank of England Annual Report
patterns.desc: The Bank of England Annual Report is typically published in June Week 3, which overlaps the 22–27 June window. Status is EXPECTED — verify at the Bank of England website.
patterns.action: Monitor the Bank of England website from June Week 1 for publication.

patterns.name: ONS UK House Price Index
patterns.desc: The ONS UK House Price Index typically publishes on Week 4 Wednesday and may fall in or just after this window. Cross-reference with Halifax HPI timing for a consistent housing narrative.
patterns.action: Verify the exact date on the ONS release calendar and prepare Lloyds Banking Group housing market comment.

patterns.name: PSR Card Scheme Remedies — Final Decision
patterns.desc: The PSR's Final Decision on Remedies for card scheme and processing fees was scheduled for May–June 2026 per the FCA Regulatory Initiatives Grid, making it EXPECTED this window or imminently — a high-relevance item for payments infrastructure.
patterns.action: Monitor the PSR website. Note implications for payments infrastructure and the competitive landscape.

patterns.name: Mansion House Speech (Chancellor + Governor)
patterns.desc: The Mansion House Speech typically occurs in July Week 2–3 (Thursday). It is not in this window but is approaching and is a major annual event for financial services policy.
patterns.action: Begin monitoring Treasury signals for expected themes and pre-brief a City/financial services reaction briefing.

events.name: Treasury Select Committee — FCA Accountability Sessions
events.institution: House of Commons Treasury Select Committee
events.desc: TSC hearings on FCA accountability (motor finance, Consumer Duty) are an active annual pattern. The week of 22–27 June is likely still within the parliamentary sitting period; verify the parliamentary calendar for any sessions scheduled in this window. No MPC decision or HM Treasury speech is confirmed within the window — the June MPC decision falls today (18 June), with the next on 30 July 2026.

events.name: Motor Finance Commission Redress Scheme — Policy Statement
events.desc: The FCA's consultation on the industry-wide consumer redress scheme closed 12 December 2025, with a Policy Statement and final rules expected in early 2026. As of this briefing it has not been confirmed as published. HIGH PRIORITY for the Group given Black Horse's direct exposure. Verify at fca.org.uk daily.

events.name: Consumer Duty — Scope & Distribution Chain Consultation
events.desc: Consultation on the application and requirements of the Consumer Duty, including through distribution chains, was planned for H1 2026 — expected during this window or imminently. High relevance given distribution chain implications. Verify at fca.org.uk.

events.name: PSR Card Scheme & Processing Fees — Final Decision on Remedies
events.desc: Final Decision on Remedies for the market review of card scheme and processing fees was scheduled for May–June 2026 per the FCA Grid — expected this window or imminently. High relevance for payments infrastructure. Verify at psr.org.uk.

events.name: SM&CR Reforms — Phase 1 Implementation
events.desc: Following Policy Statements and final rules, the first phase of SM&CR reforms was expected mid-2026, meaning implementation may be imminent. High relevance for senior management accountability. Verify at fca.org.uk.

events.name: Bank of England Financial Stability Report
events.date: Typically June Week 2 — may fall this window
events.desc: The bi-annual FSR is the highest-priority unconfirmed item for next week. If not yet published this June, it may fall in the 22–27 June window. Governor press conference follows publication. Verify immediately at bankofengland.co.uk.

events.name: ONS UK House Price Index
events.desc: The ONS UK House Price Index typically publishes in late June and may fall in or just after this window. No ONS releases were confirmed within 22–27 June in the data retrieved; verify the full calendar at ons.gov.uk/releasecalendar. Today's Labour Market release (18 June) and the June MPC decision both sit outside next week's window.

events.name: UK Finance Mortgage Lending Data
events.desc: UK Finance mortgage lending data is typically published in Week 3 and may fall within the 22–27 June window. Verify at ukfinance.org.uk/data-and-research. Note: Halifax House Price Index (first Friday) and the Lloyds Business Barometer (first Tuesday) have already been released this month — next releases are in July.

lanes.title: Competitor Watch
lanes.empty: No major bank results expected in this window. H1 reporting begins late July/early August. Challenger banks (Revolut, Monzo, Starling) follow no fixed public calendar — monitor newsrooms daily for ad-hoc product news or any FCA enforcement action.

events.name: Buy Now Pay Later — Regulation Go-Live Build-Up
events.desc: BNPL becomes a regulated activity on 15 July 2026. Expect pre-implementation communications and building media coverage in this window. Relevant for the Group's consumer credit and competitive positioning narrative.

events.name: Advice Guidance Boundary Review — Targeted Support Regime
events.desc: The new targeted support regime was scheduled to go live April–June 2026 and may now be live or recently launched. If live, expect ongoing media and industry commentary. Monitor FCA communications and trade press.

events.name: LTI Flow Limit Changes
events.desc: The PRA and FCA planned to implement the FPC's LTI recommendation during H2 2026, following a Q1 2026 Consultation Paper. The consultation may have closed; watch for a Policy Statement. High relevance for mortgage lending volumes.

lanes.title: Lloyds Banking Group Standing Publications
lanes.empty: The Halifax House Price Index (next: Friday 3 July 2026) and Lloyds Business Barometer (next: Tuesday 7 July 2026) fall outside this window. The Group's quarterly H1 results are next expected in July. No standing publication actions are required this week.

notes.label: MPC decision (today, not next week):
notes.text: The June MPC decision falls today, Thursday 18 June 2026, not in next week's window. Bank Rate has been maintained at 3.75% since at least April 2026. Next decision: 30 July 2026. Ensure today's decision is captured in the current briefing cycle.

notes.label: ONS Labour Market (today):
notes.text: UK Labour Market statistics for June 2026 were released today at 7:00am — a major data release to capture in today's briefing. No ONS releases were confirmed within the 22–27 June window in the data retrieved; verify the full ONS calendar.

notes.label: Motor finance redress scheme — OVERDUE:
notes.text: The FCA's Policy Statement was expected Feb/Mar 2026 and is not confirmed as published. HIGH PRIORITY watch item given Black Horse's direct exposure — check fca.org.uk daily.

notes.label: Bank of England FSR — top unconfirmed item:
notes.text: The bi-annual Financial Stability Report is typically June (Week 2). If not yet published this June, it may fall in the 22–27 June window — verify immediately at bankofengland.co.uk.

notes.label: Parliamentary recess:
notes.text: Parliament typically rises in late July, so the week of 22–27 June is likely still a sitting period. Verify the parliamentary calendar for any Treasury Select Committee hearings.

notes.label: Think tanks / policy bodies:
notes.text: No confirmed publications from the Resolution Foundation, IFS, NIESR or TheCityUK were identified for this window — monitor their websites directly.

notes.label: No clash alert this week:
notes.text: The "MPC Decision + ONS Data Clash Week" pattern (Very High confidence, 12 precedents) is active today but both events fall on 18 June, outside next week's window. No clash is detected for 22–27 June.

notes.label: Verification reminder:
notes.text: All items marked EXPECTED or WATCH must be verified against primary sources before inclusion in any client-facing briefing. Do not state specific dates for unconfirmed events.
